title: api-contract-design-skill Output
description: Output contract summarizing the produced API_Contract.json

contract_path.description: Path to the written API_Contract.json file.

endpoint_count.description: Total number of endpoint paths defined in the contract.

protected_endpoint_count.description: Number of endpoints with security: [{ BearerAuth: [] }].

public_endpoint_count.description: Number of endpoints explicitly marked as public (security: []).

security_schemes.description: List of security scheme names defined in components/securitySchemes.

health_endpoint_present.description: Whether /api/health GET endpoint is defined in the contract.

all_architecture_endpoints_covered.description: True only if every route handler in Architecture.md maps to an endpoint in this contract.

uncovered_endpoints.description: List of Architecture.md endpoints not yet covered by this contract. Should be empty.

reusable_components_count.description: Number of $ref components defined in components/schemas.

architecture_decisions_entry.description: Summary line appended to Architecture_Decisions.md: 'API_Contract.json: N endpoints, M protected, security: BearerAuth'.

compliance_issues.description: List of compliance issues found during quality gate check. Must be empty for contract to pass.
